candidate_observation.catch_find_target_position: Vector2; frame-aligned track, independent from the primary actor position.
candidate_observation.choose_active_selection: int; check option bounds and selected-position correspondence; source-frame only.
candidate_observation.count_displayed_count: int; validate configured count range and x/y position encoding; never read target_count.
candidate_observation.hit_target_position: Vector2; same finite per-run vector repeated across all frames.
candidate_observation.pilot_target_x: float; expected invariant under gameplay-seed mutation; never convert to Vector2.
candidate_observation.required_presence: Every declared selector candidate must be present and exact-typed for every source frame; otherwise BLOCK.

comparison_rules.editorial_mutation: safe state, per-field candidate hashes and simulation input hash MUST equal baseline; request, plan and editorial hashes MUST differ
comparison_rules.first_failure: Stop immediately and emit nine selector rows; later rows NOT_RUN_AFTER_FIRST_FAILURE
comparison_rules.gameplay_seed_mutation: safe_projection_state_sha256 MUST differ for all nine selectors; request/plan hashes are not substitutes
comparison_rules.music_seed_mutation: safe state, per-field candidate hashes and simulation input hash MUST equal baseline; request and plan identities MUST differ
comparison_rules.other_candidate_gameplay_mutation: declared candidate hash MUST differ for hit/catch/find/choose/count
comparison_rules.pilot_target_x_gameplay_mutation: candidate hash MUST remain equal; safe base projection must still differ

gameplay_seed_mutation_rule: DETERMINISTIC_NEXT_INTEGER_WITH_WRAP; source seed + 1, wrap 2147483646 to 1; no automatic seed generation

identity_model.candidate_field_probe_sha256: Separate aggregate over individual allowlisted candidate-field hashes; raw values are never emitted.
identity_model.canonical_plan_hash: Canonical plan identity; not output-sensitivity evidence.
identity_model.canonical_request_hash: Canonical universal request identity; not output-sensitivity evidence.
identity_model.editorial_hash: Resolved editorial-only identity; must change only for editorial mutation.
identity_model.payload_identity: NOT_CREATED; must never be synthesized from the safe-state or candidate hashes.
identity_model.projection_instance_identity_sha256: Binds selector, pinned source/mechanic, projection version, gameplay seed, music seed, and editorial hash.
identity_model.safe_projection_state_sha256: Hash of the ordered in-memory base FrameSnapshot projection; this alone is the gameplay-seed output sensitivity oracle.
